sources.location: first 300 kB (HTTP range) of 20210316_NSN_L1.raw, _Chymo.raw, _PPE.raw, a2ml1_trypsin.raw, a2ml1_trypsin_chymotrypsin.raw at ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2022/06/PXD032010/

claims.evidence: PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; recombinant human A2ML1 expressed in HEK293-F cells
Samples are purified recombinant protein digests; no tissue/disease. Inferred, not stated.

Seven proteases listed in Methods (trypsin, thermolysin, HNE, cathepsin G, V8, PPE, chymotrypsin) match file suffixes Thermo, HNE, CatG, GluC, PPE, Chymo; glyco files named a2ml1_trypsin and a2ml1_trypsin_chymotrypsin. Row 1 (20210316_NSN_L1.raw) = trypsin is INFERRED by elimination.
Raw headers and PD InstrumentDescription say Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap; paper says Q Exactive Orbitrap. PRIDE metadata (Orbitrap Eclipse) is wrong for these files.

Methods; row 9 two agents (trypsin and chymotrypsin; Byonic cleavage residues KRFWYLMAIV). PPE and cathepsin G have no MS CV term: MS:1001956 unspecific cleavage used, matching authors' no-enzyme search.

claims.value: Oxidation(M,P), Deamidated(N), Acetyl N-term, Met-loss, Met-loss+Acetyl (all variable)
claims.evidence: PD DynamicModification settings; paper says Q/N deamidation but PD node lists N only; no static modification
Byonic fixed mod; N-glycan search (132 human N-glycans, rare1) not encoded
Search settings (paper says 0.02 Da for PD)
Methods. EThcD supplemental HCD 10% not encoded.

limitations: No existing PXD032010 SDRF in sdrf-annotated-datasets (Step 0.5 checked).
Row 1 protease (trypsin) inferred by elimination; paper does not name which file is trypsin in the bait-region series.
PPE and cathepsin G not in MS CV; encoded as unspecific cleavage.
Skin-extract gel-slice experiment described in the paper has no raw files in the deposit and is not annotated.
Whether trypsin and chymotrypsin were applied simultaneously or sequentially in the glyco digest is not stated.
Alkylation/reduction for in-solution digests not described; columns omitted.
Q/N deamidation: PD settings list N only.
sdrf-tools reconcile flags 3 cleavage and 1 instrument finding as false positives (its digest vocabulary lacks thermolysin/elastase/unspecific; dataset has two instruments).
